owner_decision_evidence: User project owner instructed 'menutup FZ-04' after explicitly accepting ADR-03F-01..12

items.decision: Dedicated lms-user and lms-admin public OIDC Code+PKCE S256; lms-api resource-client role namespace, dedicated audience mapper, scoped roles and backend fail-closed checks. Preserve HRM clients and scopes unchanged.
items.deferred: Installed Keycloak runtime/feature checks; exact lms-api client flags, redirect/logout/secret policies; Client Scopes Evaluate effective JWT claims; FE deployment env; JWKS freshness; internal service auth and admin adapter independent ADRs.
items.hard_gate: 3B identity configuration specification before Phase 4 provisioning; Phase 4 effective-token and HRM regression checks; internal trust and role-admin ADR before their endpoints.

items.decision: Four service-owned logical DBs (Learning, Mentorship, Knowledge, Audit) on existing PostgreSQL instance; Gateway/Assistant have no canonical business database by default.
items.deferred: Exact database identifiers, roles, schema naming, DDL, migrations, grants, backup/restore.
items.hard_gate: 3B schema/grant fixtures; Phase 4 owner-DB provisioning and negative cross-write tests.

items.decision: Learning owns enrollment and progress, initially one enrollment per principal/course with pinned curriculum revision; prior earned completion is not silently revoked.
items.deferred: Retake policy, archive continuation, reset/completion rubric, concurrency and unknown ID response specifics.
items.hard_gate: 3B versioned API DTO/decision matrix; Phase 5 before Learning stateful endpoints.

items.decision: Initially capacity-one, 1:1 slot-based mentorship; PostgreSQL transactional occupancy uniqueness, never only count-before-insert.
items.deferred: Final booking states/occupied status, time-zone rules, cancellation/reschedule and capacity variations.
items.hard_gate: 3B policy+DDL test fixtures; Phase 7 concurrent booking and lifecycle tests.

items.decision: Mentorship-owned durable idempotency request record; scoped request-hash/key and response replay; same-key different payload conflicts; separate occupancy invariant.
items.deferred: TTL/retention, status/error shape and maximum key payload, replay policy.
items.hard_gate: 3B OpenAPI idempotency DTO; Phase 7 deterministic duplicate/concurrency/failure tests.

items.decision: Atomic local business-state/outbox intent; Redis at-least-once transport; consumer local inbox deduplication, leases and recoverable retry; no global exactly-once claim.
items.deferred: Event envelope schemas/versions, transport topology/ACL, key rotation/auth, ordering, DLQ/quarantine/retention, retry budgets.
items.hard_gate: 3B event schemas and negative fixtures; Phase 4+ broker/workers and end-to-end replay drills before event-dependent features.

items.decision: Knowledge-owned derived index staging, validated immutable release and atomic promotion; keep previous usable index on failure.
items.deferred: Exact manifest digest, ACL/version labels, source producer identity, promotion pointer, index rollback details.
items.hard_gate: 3B Knowledge ingest contract; Phase 8 authorized reindex/failure tests.

items.decision: Append-only audit facts and separately durable mutable administrative-operation workflow state; Audit database remains authority for audit history.
items.deferred: DB privileges, retention/legal policy, tamper guarantees, auditor ACL and failure handling.
items.hard_gate: 3B append-only DDL/privilege specification; Phase 6 immutable audit and outage tests.

items.decision: Role-admin operations require durable Audit intent then least-privilege Keycloak adapter, verified outcomes and reconciliation of ambiguous results; no distributed atomicity claim.
items.deferred: Operation state machine and authorization, external action idempotency, reconciliation timing, privilege/scoping and access policy.
items.hard_gate: 3B admin-operations ADR and contracts; Phase 6 negative/uncertain-result tests BEFORE role PATCH enabled.

items.decision: Backup/restore, retention, availability, runtime/concurrency and spend governance are mandatory for release; use measurement from existing shared VPS.
items.deferred: Exact RPO/RTO, retention days, worker concurrency, CPU/RAM caps and monetary thresholds are NOT defined without baseline measurement.
items.hard_gate: Phase 4 design resource preflight; Phase 11 measured operational SLO, restore, HRM nonregression before production release.

items.decision: Source-controlled Git LMS catalog is canonical; immutable manifest produced from pinned inputs; no runtime canonical course CRUD/database.
items.hard_gate: 3B manifest compiler/schema CI; Phase 5 Learning integration.

items.decision: Permanent lesson ID in checked-in frontmatter (or reviewed one-time equivalent), stable cross-release aliases/tombstones and collision/integrity checks; preserve existing stable IDs.
items.deferred: One-time mapping across all 31 existing lessons, historic routes and migration compatibility; no proof all existing users have no progress.
items.hard_gate: 3B audited ID registry + route/search parity tests; Phase 5 pre-progress migration acceptance.

items.decision: Deterministic SHA-256 canonical manifest version with JCS-style canonical input, separate course revision and public/internal-preview artifact channels.
items.deferred: Exact canonicalization inclusion, semantic revision threshold, artifact signature, retention/rollback limits.
items.hard_gate: 3B versioned schema, deterministic dual-build test; Phase 5 release publication/rollback checks.

items.decision: Enrollments pin approved course/curriculum revision; historical learning progress and earned completions never retroactively removed on unrelated course release.
items.deferred: Course completion rubric, learner opt-in upgrade policy, archived visibility and API compatibility window.

items.decision: Studio remains canonical editor/publisher; LMS holds references with source-attested edition, canon status and distribution/LLM-use rights only; no automatic canon promotion.
items.deferred: Studio authorized release registry, per-source canon proofs, license/access attributes.
items.hard_gate: 3B metadata schema contract; before Phase 8 ingestion and public/AI citation.

items.decision: Public static export and private Knowledge ingestion are independently permission-filtered; index release pinned; deny unattested/draft/unauthorized excerpts.
items.deferred: Source-attested ACL policy schema, public FE build negative suite, reindex exact integration.
items.hard_gate: 3B privacy/manifest CI; Phase 8 permission/search leakage tests; FE release checks in Phase 10.

items.decision: Creator-generated submissions, stored journal/project bible, grading and mentor review are out of initial v1 scope; may not be implemented as incidental lesson output.
items.deferred: Any future storage/file sharing/grading/reviewer workflows require new data ownership, API, capabilities, privacy, audit and retention ADR.
items.hard_gate: Only reconsider after explicit new product approval + frozen-contract change control, before coding feature.

items.decision: Studio-owned season/episode/chapter hierarchy and Current Lore/Backstory/Wiki modes remain Studio-domain references; LMS does not replicate authoritative canon graph.
items.deferred: Exact attested reference relationship metadata and publication proof.
items.hard_gate: 3B optional source reference schema; Phase 8 indexing only with Studio release authority.
